name: Cristiano Ronaldo
description: Portuguese footballer known for his incredible goal-scoring ability and multiple Ballon d'Or titles. He has played for clubs like Manchester United, Real Madrid, and Juventus.

name: Lionel Messi
description: Argentine footballer regarded as one of the greatest of all time. He has won multiple Ballon d'Or awards and led Argentina to a FIFA World Cup victory.

name: Kylian Mbappé
description: French footballer known for his speed and technical skills. He has played for Paris Saint-Germain and Real Madrid, winning multiple domestic and international titles.

name: Zlatan Ibrahimović
description: Swedish footballer famous for his acrobatic goals and strong personality. He has played for clubs like AC Milan, Barcelona, and Paris Saint-Germain.
